scope: Public files in this single controlled-failure evidence directory before final index generation
projection: Run/job/artifact IDs and terminal status; source/git/hash receipts; fixed controlled dev trace/span IDs; allowlisted APM/log attributes; numeric overhead distributions. GitHub actor/account metadata and full logs remain private.
limits: Finite static scan and field-projection review, not a general secret scanner or privacy audit. Original safe artifact receipts are copied byte-for-byte; no secrets or user payloads were present in those receipts.
